# Master Context

This is the canonical top-level context index for the repository.

Use this file to keep a concise, durable map of the most important subsystem context and to direct agents toward the deeper local docs that hold folder-specific details.

## Conventions

- This file is the default master target for Memory Summarizer.
- Additive subsystem history belongs in the nearest local `_memory.md` maintained by Memory Scribe.
- Stable folder guidance belongs in colocated markdown maintained by Markdown Manager, usually an existing `README.md` or a local `_context.md` when no suitable folder doc exists.
- Keep entries short here and link or point to deeper docs instead of duplicating them.

## How To Use This File

- Add one entry per subsystem or folder family when durable context is worth surfacing globally.
- Summarize only the highest-signal facts: purpose, major boundaries, important conventions, and common traps.
- Include pointers to the local `_memory.md` and the richer folder markdown when they exist.
- Refresh entries when subsystem structure changes materially.
